    • rewindBeforeInvocationId

      public Optional<String> rewindBeforeInvocationId()
      On a rewind event, the ID of the invocation to rewind before: the history from that invocation up to the rewind event is dropped. ADK Java does not apply rewinds itself; the field exists for runtimes that do, such as ADK Kotlin.

    • setRewindBeforeInvocationId

      public void setRewindBeforeInvocationId(@Nullable String rewindBeforeInvocationId)

    • route

      @Experimental public Optional<com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<Route>> route()
      For a workflow node, returns the routes this event selects; an edge is followed when it has one of these routes. The value is optional because an empty list is still a routing decision that selects no route, whereas an absent value means the event makes no routing decision. When merging, an empty list replaces the existing routes, while an absent value keeps them.
